a.lede: Restrictions were made by California's DMV after a driverless Waymo was caught trying to pass a Highway Patrol vehicle that was slowing traffic.
a.title: Waymo is pausing all freeway rides after California DMV says the robotaxis are 'imminent hazard to public safety'

b.lede: Waymo temporarily paused service in San Francisco after several robotaxis caused traffic jams as they were unable to navigate flooded streets during a storm.
b.title: Waymo pauses service in San Francisco after robotaxis get stuck on flooded streets
